nodes.title: equal_range()
nodes.markdown:
Returns the pair of iterators `[lower_bound, upper_bound)` for a value in a sorted range.

Useful for counting occurrences in `O(log n)`.
nodes.syntax:
auto [lo, hi] = equal_range(v.begin(), v.end(), x);
int occurrences = hi - lo;
nodes.notes: The range must already be sorted.

nodes.title: accumulate()
nodes.markdown: Folds a range into a single value. Lives in `<numeric>`.
nodes.notes: Pass `0LL` (not `0`) when the sum may exceed the range of `int`.
